description: Automated validation checkpoint halting pipeline execution if code quality, coverage, or security criteria are missed.
Practice of defining, versioning, and enforcing governance and security rules using executable code.
Security control (CICD-SEC-1) ensuring code passes mandatory reviews and checks before production deployment.
Governance rule requiring at least two independent individuals to review and approve changes prior to release.
Configured percentage of code statements or branches that must be executed by automated tests.
